title: Fleet Tamer: Interactive Scaling Controls and Throughput Chronicle
creator: Anika Rao
description: Design and deliver a Console-first feature set for Dedicated fleets that lets operators tune autoscaling intent, pin throughput guarantees, and investigate a detailed change history that explains scaling decisions. Focus areas: an interactive scaling dial + policy preview, per-fleet throughput horizon and percentile latency charts, a deterministic change timeline with diffs and rollback, and RBAC-safe operator overrides exposed in the Console and API.
comments: 2025-02-19 - PM review: prioritize deterministic rollback UX and clear customer-visible SLA descriptions. Avoid ambiguous 'recommended' controls that hide cost impact.
2025-02-21 - ENG feedback (S. Kim): kernel-level autoscaling hook added; product should expose expected provisioning delay and warm-up window in UI.

2025-02-24 - Design note (M. Ortega): created two variants — 'Precision' (fine-grained slider + numeric inputs) and 'Preset-driven' (Safe / Balanced / Cost-Optimized) — prefer Precision for initial MVP.
2025-02-26 - Security (L. Zhao): RBAC mapping must disallow runtime overrides for tier 'customer-managed' fleets; added ticket ENG-20011 to gate API endpoints.

2025-03-01 - QA (R. Patel): telemetry smoke tests passing; observed edge-case where canary scale increase does not surface in change timeline when autoscale policy auto-merged. Follow-up patch in ENG-20345.
updates: 2025-02-18 - Ticket created with scope and success metrics: reduce manual overprovision events by 40% for large fleets, and provide 99th percentile throughput SLA visibility.
2025-02-20 - Design prototype v1 uploaded; includes interactive throughput dial and throughput horizon chart for past 14 days.
2025-02-22 - Backend API contract drafted (GET /fleets/:id/scaling-intent, POST /fleets/:id/override); draft shared with ENG for schema validation.
2025-02-25 - Implementation spike completed: autoscale policy preview computed locally in Console to avoid chasing backend warm-up; confirms estimated token/sec and cost delta.
2025-02-28 - Integration: change-history service now emits 'policy-applied' and 'operator-override' events with diff payloads; Console shows diffs inline.
2025-03-02 - Design review: consolidated controls into single panel with 'Preview impact' flow; moving to PR and handoff to eng for final polish.
2025-03-02 - Status: In Review — design + API contract awaiting ENG final signoff and small security gating adjustments.
